description: MIB-R prototype profile — Memory Intelligence Benchmark, Reality Track. Realistic external-task transfer under paired memory interventions. Prototype only: there is deliberately no official MIB-R Score, and MIB-R results are never ranked against MIB-Core.

calibration.note: An annotated Reality transfer edge is admissible only when an oracle Skill under oracle routing measurably improves the target task. A curator-labelled Ability is not useful merely because it sounds plausible.

reporting.note: Transfer graphs are especially vulnerable to adaptive reverse engineering across repeated submissions, so per-task feedback is not part of the immediate public surface.
